review: Hai să fim serioși. Nine years I have held the young-adults ministry together at a Romanian Baptist church of six hundred, and every single week I stand between parents who want Romanian and young adults who think in English. Three points. One — "Jubilujah" in Romanian is the first thing I have ever been able to put in front of both halves of that room without a fight. Two — I put it in front of eighty people inside a month. Three — my father was interrogated twice in the eighties for meetings in the house and has never described it, and I raised my kids in a suburb, and the gap between those two facts is the thing I do not know how to close. This album does not close it either. It names it.
